title: Sequencer equivocation (fork proof)
notes: PublicNotice MUST name checkpoint IDs/hashes and link to any fork/equivocation evidence by digest.

title: Witness quorum outage / DDoS
notes: PublicNotice MUST name affected endpoints + time windows; point to URP/attestations by digest.

title: Network partition / routing incident
notes: Prefer multi-vantage evidence (RIPE Atlas/OONI) referenced by digest; avoid screenshots.

title: Mass revocation / RA compromise attempt
notes: PublicNotice MUST declare freeze scope + what signatures/time ranges are suspect; link to KeyCompromiseEvent by digest.

title: Malware campaign affecting voter devices
notes: PublicNotice MUST separate confirmed facts vs guidance; avoid device fingerprinting; link to mitigations checklist.

title: Trustee compromise suspicion during tally
notes: PublicNotice SHOULD state contingency threshold changes and next planned update time.

title: Proof verification failure (ZK/consistency)
notes: PublicNotice MUST include reproduction steps and expected digests for verifier outputs.

title: Paper-vs-crypto discrepancy (audit escalation)
notes: PublicNotice MUST avoid claims of finality; include audit escalation plan + timing.

title: Traffic-analysis / turnout surveillance allegation
notes: Rumor-control notices SHOULD link to threat model/privacy design and explicitly state disclosure boundaries.

title: Supply-chain compromise detected (provenance mismatch)
notes: PublicNotice MUST link to provenance statements and specify which builds/releases are impacted.

title: Verifier bug / monoculture failure (false pass)
notes: Correction notice MUST specify affected verifier versions and provide reproduction + fixed digests.

title: Insider exfiltration of access logs / network identifiers
notes: PublicNotice MUST avoid leaking additional identifiers; include support resources and next update time.

title: Official channel takeover / forged statement
notes: Publish a PublicNotice from an out-of-band channel; include a 'how to verify official channels' section + digest short-form for copy/paste.

title: Deepfake/synthetic media claim about election operations
notes: Avoid re-amplifying the artifact; prefer pointing to provenance assertions by digest (if available) and publish a time-bounded update cadence.

title: DDoS + selective submission dropping
notes: PublicNotice SHOULD separate "slow/partial access" from "lost submissions" and name any receipt states/time windows by digest pointers.

title: Ballot definition substitution / EPB mismatch
notes: PublicNotice MUST publish the canonical EPB digest and describe who is impacted (scope) without doxxing; attach diff evidence by digest.

title: VRDB snapshot regression / rollback attempt
notes: PublicNotice SHOULD include the last-known-good snapshot digest and an explicit "freeze" decision if eligibility/status data may be stale.

title: ENR drift / fake results injection
notes: PublicNotice MUST distinguish unofficial ENR from certified results; provide a canonical ENRUpdate digest and guidance for independent verification.

title: Credential recovery fraud wave
notes: PublicNotice SHOULD provide safe guidance (avoid phishing amplification) and name support channels + next update cadence; preserve privacy boundaries.

title: Domain hijack / certificate mis-issuance for fake notices
notes: Issue an out-of-band PublicNotice that teaches observers what to trust (mirror list + digest short-form); point to any CT/DNS evidence by digest when available.

title: Comms digest mismatch across official channels
notes: If a PublicNotice digest appears on some official channels but not others (or differs), treat as split-view or compromise. Publish a new PublicNotice naming affected channel_id(s), time window, and evidence pointers; shift parity checks to surviving channels.

title: Missed next update commitment (comms SLA breach)
notes: Publish a status_update PublicNotice that supersedes the prior notice; acknowledge the delay, explain the cause, reset next_update_at, and attach any breach proof/receipts when available.

title: Conflicting reports / information overload (uncertainty-safe update)
notes: Drill human process under pressure: conflicting external claims, incomplete internal info. PublicNotice MUST use epistemic tags + next_update_at commitment (219).

title: Forged “official statement” circulates (time-to-refute drill)
notes: Assume deepfake/forged screenshot of an official claim. Response MUST be digest-first: publish authenticity verdict as PublicNotice + point to packet digest. Track and measure time-to-refute target (194.4).

title: “We published it” but operationally useless (legibility theater test)
notes: Test minimal-effort compliance failure: giant scans/unstable links/no indexes. Drill producing bounded, mirrorable artifacts (manifest digest, digest cards) and emit a PublicationCoverageReport / suppression report if needed (187).

title: Selective delivery / geoblock (split-view publication)
notes: Drill selective delivery: different bytes by geo/UA/language/cookies/WAF. Publish parity snapshots + request-context capture notes; issue an incident_advisory PublicNotice naming affected surfaces, time window, and verification pointers.

title: Political pressure to publish unverified claims (hold the line)
notes: Drill refusal to overclaim under pressure. PublicNotice MUST separate known/unknown, commit next_update_at, cite reproducible evidence pointers, and avoid declaring certification/results beyond authority.

title: Pressure to promote remote ballot return (premature Track B→A promotion)
notes: Drill refusing premature scope expansion: publish a bounded PublicNotice that front-loads non-claims (167), cites promotion guardrails (229.7), and states the rollback/fallback posture. Treat marketing-scope creep as an integrity incident, not a PR debate.
